mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (as measured by the current level) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year) and a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), an increase in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 months), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is rising (month-over-month increase), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of weak GDP growth (GDPC1 < 2.0% annualized) and declining retail sales (RSAFS < 0.5% month-over-month) signals a slowing consumer demand cycle that reduces corporate revenue growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 2.0% and RSAFS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5%), the labor market slack suppresses wage growth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
